# Code Anchors: Workbook Name

- `components/commands/nxsx.teach-plan.md` — passes a workbook name only when the lead gave one, and never makes one up
- `src/workbook-cli.ts` — the optional name for an epic or an initiative, and the initiative title read once to default it
- `src/roadmap-cli.spec.ts` — the name taken from the initiative
- `components/commands/nxsx.teach.md` — the re-plan passes the workbook's name explicitly, never derived from the epic's changed title
